notes: Local backup: Settings can export/import a versioned JSON backup of aliases, pins/mutes/hidden, drafts, queued prompts, attachment drafts, snippets and safe preferences via SAF, with schema/5MB validation, secret exclusion, destructive-replace confirmation and no host tokens/app lock/caches. Also hardens host-wide search so its 3s budget covers the whole request including session list and snapshot reads (live q=release now 3.24s vs 4.9s) and refreshes the 200-idea feature catalog through 0.2.103.
